structure_source: human-designed; no LLM generated the nodes, edges or conflict rules

sort_scores_steps: read each uniquely named Name, midterm1, midterm2 column from score.xlsx
sort complete rows by numeric midterm1 descending with stable ties
write only data/sorted_score.xlsx without changing source; keep host-only reference outside staged and committed artifacts
split_scores_steps: read the unique Name, midterm1, midterm2 columns from score.xlsx
write two separate data/midtermN.xlsx workbooks without replacing source
keep host-only references outside staged and committed artifacts
roster_count_steps: identify unique student IDs and full names
course_requirement_steps: parse distinct Course ID values with strict CS/MATH department prefixes
count both departments and compare each minimum
write source-derived Yes/No with counts to answer.txt
homework_sum_steps: locate unique Last Name match in the roster
read finite numeric HW1, HW2, HW3 by column header
sum the three scores and write source-derived data/answer.txt without modifying workbook

output: host-only exact-match active-sheet bidirectional value comparisons

conflicts.same_file_writes: serial; staging file per task; reject competing writes to same cell or path
conflicts.independent_readonly_verifiers: parallel after staged artifact is closed
conflicts.merge: commit only if every branch approves the same staged SHA-256 and expected output path
conflicts.on_failure: do not modify input or commit output; preserve stage and trace with failure reason
